searchText: Is it possible to know how many fellows are working on this project doubt so, unless we go through each fellow's update I think quite a lot, I remember atleast 10 peeps mentioning it yesterday Not sure if you have seen the updates that <@774033563732541451> did here https://hackmd.io/@jsign/cohort-three-update-1 - it goes up to https://hackmd.io/@jsign/cohort-three-update-15. I enjoyed following it to get an overall understanding of the space (thanks <@774033563732541451> !) maybe obvious warn: have in mind that we kept making progress :) so some things can be outdated or some problems already tackled. I think it's still very valuable 🙂 will add it to the list understood. it was interesting to see your thought process digging into a dense subject 🙂
